name: Intercom
prompt: Build a live chat widget for websites with: embeddable JS snippet, real-time chat via WebSockets, agent dashboard showing open conversations, canned responses, visitor info (page URL, browser), chat history, and email fallback when agents are offline. Node.js + SQLite backend, simple admin panel.
notes: A basic live chat widget is very achievable. Intercom's AI, product tours, and omnichannel are the expensive parts.
